message.content: The filing confirms Apple's FY2024 operating income of $123,216 million (up 7.8% from $114,301M in FY2023), on total net sales of $391,035M, with gross margin expanding to 46.2% and Services revenue up 13% to $96,169M. Net income dipped to $93,736M only because of the one-time $10.2B State Aid tax charge — operating performance itself improved. With the stock at $222.70, I'll place a single buy order just above the ask.
